note: Recurring bill providers, for spotting price hikes and pointing the user at the official page to change plans or cancel. Internet, mobile and insurance prices are often negotiable or can be re-quoted; regulated utilities are not (see the budget billing and assistance links instead). Phone numbers appear only inside notes and only where the cited provider page shows them. Rows with verified=false could not be read on the provider's site. Several descriptors are shared (AT&T and Verizon serve both internet and mobile; COMCAST/XFINITY, SPECTRUM and OPTIMUM also bill their mobile services): the longest matching entry wins and ties go to the earlier row.

providers.notes: The cancel article lists three ways to cancel: call 1-800-934-6489, schedule a callback, or visit an Xfinity Store. It describes no online self-service cancellation (www.xfinity.com/cancel shows the same content). The same page links plan changes to https://www.xfinity.com/digital?buyflow=changeplan. Returning equipment is free at an Xfinity store or with a UPS prepaid label from xfinity.com/returns (support/articles/returning-your-equipment). Unreturned rental equipment can appear as a charge on the final bill (support/articles/important-information-when-canceling-services). None of these pages states ETF or promo-expiry terms. The account_url title is 'XFINITY | My Account'. COMCAST and XFINITY descriptors are shared with Xfinity Mobile.

KM1009500: only the account owner can cancel, by calling 800.288.2020 with the account number and PIN. Online cancellation exists only for AT&T Internet Air accounts in IL, MA and NY. The cancellation-policy page (att.com/support/how-to/cancellation-policy-internet/) adds: no ETF within 14 days of activation; after that, a term commitment brings a prorated ETF; leased equipment must be returned. The equipment-return page (att.com/support/how-to/internet/equipment-return/) gives 21 days after disconnect to avoid a non-return fee (amount not stated there). Wall-mounted fiber jacks and ONTs stay in place. Returns go to The UPS Store or a company-owned FedEx Office, not a drop box. Plan change: sign in at account_url, then 'Manage internet' (support/article/my-account/KM1010033). account_url redirects to AT&T sign-in. AT&T and ATT* descriptors are shared with AT&T Wireless, so tell them apart by email content or amount.

Fios customers can disconnect online through My Verizon chat (type 'disconnect', pick 'Disconnect Fios home service', chat with a rep). They can also call 1-800-VERIZON (800-837-4966), Mon-Fri 8-7 ET or Sat 8-5 ET, as listed on the cancel page. Other home services, such as DSL, must contact customer service. Contract ETF is prorated, capped at $350, and drops $15 per month. Rented equipment must be returned within 30 days of disconnecting to avoid an unreturned-equipment charge. account_url redirects to secure.verizon.com/signin ('My Verizon login'), which covers both Wireless and Fios. The 'VERIZON' descriptor is shared with Verizon Wireless.

Cox is now Spectrum. The page title reads 'Manage Your Spectrum Services | Cancel Service | Cox is now Spectrum'; azfamily.com (2026-10-12) reports the Charter-Cox merger closed in August 2026. WebFetch returned only the title, so the body was read from the raw HTML. It says to change or cancel by calling 800-234-3993 or by signing in, with at least 24 hours' notice to disconnect. Services are prorated except Spectrum Mobile, which bills the full cycle. Equipment goes back to a Spectrum store or any UPS Store. The account_url is the sign-in link on that page and sits behind a bot-check interstitial. Former Cox customers' bills and descriptors may switch to SPECTRUM or CHARTER.

No dedicated cancel help article was found: optimum.net/support lists none, and faq.optimum.net returned HTTP 402. cancel_or_retention therefore points to the official Residential Terms ('Optimum' = CSC Holdings). The terms say cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period, with no refunds for partial periods. Cancelling or downgrading before a promotional 'Initial Term' ends brings an early cancellation fee, which may be charged automatically. Equipment must be returned promptly, or unreturned-equipment charges and continuing monthly fees apply. Offer terms on optimum.com/moving say to cancel by phone (numbers vary by offer, e.g. 877-794-2724) or by logging into the account at optimum.net. account_url is linked from that page and redirects to the auth.optimum.net sign-in. Bare 'OPTIMUM' may collide with unrelated merchants and is shared with Optimum Mobile. SUDDENLINK is a legacy brand.

The cancel page gives phone 1-855-956-4702 and describes no online cancellation. It offers a pause of 1-9 months. On disconnect, a $50 restocking fee per household applies, and unreturned equipment costs up to $150 per device (up to $500 for 5 Gig). The Help Center page (frontier.com/helpcenter/account/disconnecting-your-service) mentions 'Chat with us' and gives 30 days to return equipment (UPS Store QR code or mailed kit). An ETF applies if service is cancelled before a contract or promo period ends. Residential internet is billed in full through the end of the cycle, with no partial credit. The site footer reads 'Frontier, a Verizon Company'; the acquisition closed 2026-01-20. Avoid bare 'FRONTIER', which collides with Frontier Airlines. Some frontier.com/helpcenter URLs return 403 to WebFetch.

Google Fiber is now branded gFiber: fiber.google.com and support.google.com/fiber/answer/3103541 both 301-redirect to gfiber.com. To cancel, contact a rep (live chat, email or phone via Contact Us) with the Support PIN. No self-service online cancellation is described. Partial months are not prorated. Equipment must be returned within 60 days or a replacement fee applies (gfiber.com/legal/schedule/). Refund credit arrives within 19 days of the final statement. No cancellation fee or contract is mentioned. Plans can be changed any time in the app or web portal (gfiber.com/support/en/answer/1843/). account_url redirects to signin.gfiber.com.

A line can be disconnected online (My Verizon > Chat with us > type 'Cancel') or by phone; the page lists 800-922-0204 and 1-800-VERIZON and suggests calling first to check for offers. Cancellation takes effect on the last day of the billing period. Device Payment balances must be paid off first, or they are charged in full on the final bill. Promotional monthly discounts may have to be repaid (capped at a rolling 6 months) if a line leaves before a minimum term. Plan changes are free in My Verizon > My plan (support/understand-and-change-your-plan-faqs/). account_url redirects to 'My Verizon login'. The 'VERIZON' descriptor is shared with Fios.

KM1008472: cancel or remove a line by chat or by calling 800.331.0500. Online cancellation is offered only for IL, MA and NY accounts. The bill is not prorated, so the whole bill period is charged. Unpaid installment balances, including accessories, are due on the final bill. Devices activated within the last 14 days can be returned under the return policy. Plan change: att.com/acctmgmt/signin?intent=MANAGE-PLAN or the AT&T app (KM1010787). account_url redirects to AT&T sign-in. Descriptors are shared with AT&T Internet. Cricket is AT&T-owned but bills separately.

t-mobile.com returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so these pages were read with a plain HTTP GET. The account_url title is 'Log In To Your T-Mobile Account'. The cancel page asks customers to call before cancelling and describes no online self-service cancellation; its body shows no number and links to t-mobile.com/contact-us. Cancellations are future-dated to the end of the current bill cycle. Cancelling the whole account makes remaining device (EIP) balances due on the final bill. Promo credits and multi-line discounts may end. A Home Internet gateway must be returned within 14 days, or a non-return fee of up to $370 applies. Service can be reactivated within 90 days without a new credit check. Plan changes are made in the T-Life app or on T-Mobile.com (support/account/add-or-remove-services).

Mint Mobile is prepaid. mintmobile.com returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so the help pages were read with a plain HTTP GET (some of those requests were blocked too). account_url is the target of the 'mintmobile.com/login' link in the help articles. Plan changes and Auto Renewal cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Auto Renewal is turned off in the app (Account > Payment method) or on the website (My Account > Payment). If Auto Renewal is off and the plan is not renewed, the account goes into suspension. The change-plan article (help/how-do-i-change-my-plan/) says more data can be bought mid-cycle, a smaller data plan applies only from the next plan, and plan length cannot change once a plan has started.

Cancellation is self-service online: in the app or on the web, go to My Account > Settings > Cancel service. It is not immediate; service ends on the next payment due date, and 'Undo cancellation request' works until then. Port the number out before cancelling to keep it. Plan switches: upgrades apply immediately, downgrades at the next cycle (same page). Help comes from the Care team by chat. The plain /help/managing-visible-account URL is an empty JS shell, so use the /m/help/ URL. FLAG: 'VISIBLE' is a common word and the exact bank descriptor was not confirmed; pair it with amount or visible.com email. The site footer links to Verizon terms (Visible is a Verizon brand).

No dedicated cancellation article was found, so cancel_or_retention is the change-plan article. Plans change online (cricketwireless.com/planupgrade) or in the myCricket app, effective the first day of the next cycle. The limit is 2 plan changes per cycle, scheduled at least 3 days before the cycle starts. Changes can reduce Group Save discounts. Multi-month plans cannot be changed or cancelled until the last 30 days. The Terms (cricketwireless.com/terms §1.5) say service can be cancelled any time, with no proration or refund of unused service, and charges apply until the account is cancelled. support/billing-and-payments/suspend-and-restore-service.html lists 24/7 chat, 611 and 1-800-CRICKET (274-2538). Bare 'CRICKET' was avoided.

Cancel by phone only: GEICO FAQ says call (800) 841-1587 to speak with a licensed agent (at the voice menu say 'cancel insurance policy', then 'auto'); have the policy number ready. FAQ states no cancellation fee; North Carolina policies may be subject to a Short Rate premium calculation. Coverage changes are made online after login under 'My Policy Details'. Re-quoting or shopping around is the general lever; the FAQ itself does not mention renewal timing.

Progressive auto FAQ: to cancel, 'contact us and a representative will help you cancel your policy'; prepaid premium is refunded. Policy changes (vehicles, drivers, address, coverage) can be made any time by logging in or calling 1-800-776-4737, and some changes alter the premium. Progressive's general cancel guide (https://www.progressive.com/answers/how-to-cancel-car-insurance/) says a cancellation fee may apply depending on state and timing, and advises having the new policy in force first. The login link redirects to account.apps.progressive.com (a JavaScript sign-in page).

State Farm cancel page: 'There isn't a fee to cancel your policy'; 'you can't cancel online'. Cancel by phone through the local State Farm agent (provide policy number, name and date of birth) or in person at the agent's office; phone cancellation is usually effective immediately or can be scheduled for a later date. Some states require informing the DMV. Coverage changes can be requested online via 'Quote/Change Coverages' and are forwarded to the agent (https://www.statefarm.com/customer-care/faqs/insurance). The cancel page body was read by direct HTTP fetch because WebFetch returned only the title.

Allstate help page, 'Cancel a policy': 'We're sorry to hear you're considering canceling your policy. Please contact Allstate for assistance.' Chat support runs 24/7. No online cancel route is described. Policy changes (vehicles, drivers, coverage, address) are made in My Account by selecting the policy, then 'Edit'; existing customers wanting a quote for policy changes use Chat (https://www.allstate.com/help-support/my-policy/faqs). Login: https://myaccountrwd.allstate.com/anon/account/login. WebFetch timed out on allstate.com; the pages were read live by direct HTTP fetch on 2026-10-22.

Liberty Mutual cancel page: the process and possible fees depend on your state's insurance regulations; call 800-290-8711 to cancel. Retention lever stated on the same page: customers of at least 3 years may, depending on state, be eligible for a new rate, so call before cancelling. Moving states may not require switching insurers. The account login link is taken from the official page. WebFetch got HTTP 403 from libertymutual.com; the page was read live by direct HTTP fetch on 2026-10-22.

Rates are regulated (CPUC) and not negotiable. Budget Billing (free; monthly amount based on a 12-month rolling average and recalculated monthly; residential customers not on NEM; enroll in My Account > All billing tasks > Budget Billing): https://www.pge.com/en/account/billing-and-assistance/financial-assistance/budget-billing-program.html. Assistance (CARE: at least 20% off gas and 35% off electricity; FERA 18% off electricity; also Medical Baseline, REACH, LIHEAP, AMP, Match My Payment): https://www.pge.com/en/account/billing-and-assistance/financial-assistance.html. Start, stop or transfer service online via My Account or call 1-877-660-6789. The login URL is a JavaScript page linked from these pge.com pages.

Rates are regulated (NY PSC) and not negotiable. Budget Billing (formerly Level Payment; projected annual cost divided by 12, with a true-up at the end of the plan; residential customers enroll in My Account): https://www.coned.com/en/accounts-billing/payment-plans-assistance/budget-billing. Assistance hub (Energy Affordability Program, HEAP, Solar for All/REACH, EnergyShare): https://www.coned.com/en/accounts-billing/payment-plans-assistance/help-paying-your-bill. EAP page: https://www.coned.com/en/accounts-billing/payment-plans-assistance/energy-affordability-program. Move or stop service online; moving requires an online account and a date no more than 30 days out, and business accounts must call.

Rates are regulated (state utility commissions) and not negotiable. Budget Billing: https://www.duke-energy.com/home/billing/options/budget-billing. Annual plan needs 12 months of history at the address and settles up at 12 months; mid-year adjustment does not apply in KY and OH. Quarterly plan needs no history and has no year-end settle-up. Payment Assistance: https://www.duke-energy.com/home/billing/assistance, with a ZIP-code agency finder at /home/billing/assistance/payment-assistance-finder. Programs vary by state. Start, stop or move service: /start-stop-move/landing (stop: /start-stop-move/landing/stop). WebFetch got HTTP 403 from duke-energy.com; all pages were read live by direct HTTP fetch on 2026-10-22.

LA Fitness Membership Questions page: most memberships are month-to-month and can be cancelled at any time by (1) mailing written notice of cancellation to P.O. Box 54170, Irvine, CA 92619 (registered or certified mail recommended; keep a record), (2) in person at a club front desk, or (3) through your online account, or as otherwise provided in your agreement. Depending on your state of enrollment you may be able to cancel by email. A mailed notice postmarked at least 5 business days before the next billing date stops further billing; one postmarked later may be billed once more, and that charge is refunded. A termination fee applies when cancelling during an initial term of 3 months or more. Prepaid time stays usable. No downgrade option is described; freezes cost $10 per month for monthly members.

Equinox FAQ: 'You may cancel in club with a club manager, via mail as described in your Membership Agreement, by emailing Cancellations@Equinox.com, by phone through Equinox Concierge, or by logging into your account on Equinox.com. Notice periods vary by state', so check the Membership Agreement. 'In certain states, if you cancel soon after an increase in Membership Dues, you may have additional rights.' Freezes go through Concierge@equinox.com. Plan changes: 'We would be happy to help you adjust your membership', by contacting your club (9AM-5PM local) or Concierge@Equinox.com. Set to negotiable on that basis. The account URL redirects to the Equinox login. The bare 'EQUINOX' descriptor can collide with unrelated merchants that share the name, and with Equinox Hotels or EQX+ charges that are not club dues, so pair it with a monthly recurring amount.

Official cancel page (https://www.24hourfitness.com/members/cancel): monthly-payment members cancel online, after a retention offer of '30% Off Your Next 3 Months' Dues' (monthly-payment memberships only); the decline link goes to /myaccount/membership.html#/cancel/. Limited-term or prepaid members must 'come see a team member in club or contact us'. Homepage terms (https://www.24hourfitness.com/): 'A 30-day notice is required to cancel monthly memberships, except in NY'; dues and fees remain payable during the notice period. Commitment memberships are non-cancelable and non-refundable within the commitment period except as the agreement provides, and a cancellation fee may apply. Set to negotiable because of the official retention discount, not a plan downgrade.

Catch-all for regulated utilities not listed by name. Rates are set by a state regulator (or the city, for most water service), so the bill is not negotiable. Useful levers: ask the utility for budget billing / level pay or a payment plan, and check assistance. Per USAGov, LIHEAP helps pay heating and cooling bills (eligibility is income-based and set by each state; apply through the state or territory LIHEAP office, linked from that page as https://liheapch.acf.hhs.gov/search-tool/), and state shut-off rules are listed at https://liheapch.acf.hhs.gov/Disconnect/disconnect.htm. Those two liheapch links were taken from the USAGov page and not opened. Descriptor matching is loose: confirm with a recurring monthly amount.

NOT VERIFIED: the cancel URL is the indexed support page and was not read. spectrum.com returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients, and WebFetch timed out on it. spectrum.net is a JavaScript app, so WebFetch only saw a 'cookies are disabled' notice. Both spectrum.net URLs return HTTP 200. The raw HTML meta description of spectrum.net says it is the sign-in for viewing and paying the bill and managing the account. The support URL is indexed as 'Change or Cancel Your Spectrum Service', but its body could not be read, so no cancellation method, ETF or equipment rule is recorded here. Bare 'SPECTRUM' can collide with unrelated merchants (e.g. Spectrum Health) and is shared with Spectrum Mobile. Former Cox customers may now bill as Spectrum (see the Cox entry).

Planet Fitness FAQ ('How do I manage my membership?'): end the membership by mailing written notification to your home club, visiting your home club in person, or logging into your account through the member portal on the website. Some policies vary by location based on state and local guidelines. The club must receive notice at least 8 days before the next billing date, because billing changes take up to 7 days; the same 8-day rule applies before the annual fee date. Ending a minimum-term membership before the contract term ends requires a $58 buyout fee. Upgrades can be done online; downgrades are done in club ('stop by your club'). The live site is behind a Cloudflare challenge (WebFetch and direct fetch both got 403), so this text comes from the Wayback Machine snapshot of 2026-10-12 (https://web.archive.org/web/20261012090440/https://www.planetfitness.com/about-planet-fitness/customer-service/). The account URL is a link on that page.
